25 October 2026 — necessary capacity cuts explain early-charging failures
The separately frozen analytical diagnostic is complete. It used only previously exported energy/window diagnostics, with no original case/plan/TRAIN access, replay or optimizer. All eight reference records were available. Exactly the three45 kW references that had returned numerical INFEASIBLE violate the ideal necessary capacity inequalities. All twelve available adaptive records have no violation; the other four planned adaptive records remain unknown. These are repeated descriptions of four exposed groups, not24 independent tests.
Each bus must obtain enough grid energy before terminal opening1080 to keep its battery above reserve at final return. That minimum is compared with its own depot windows, while the shared cut uses the merged union across buses and also accounts for total energy beyond post-opening capacity. Overlapping windows are not added as separate shared capacity. The45 kW reference shortfalls are58.4333 kWh for10006,222.8389 for10009 and262.1944 for10005. Summed individual reserve deficits control the first two; total energy minus terminal capacity is stronger for10005. Exact represented rational quantities and individual-bus violations remain in the receipt.
The10006 explanation is concrete: its reference offers96 merged minutes of early charging, at most72 kWh at45 kW, against130.4333 kWh required. The admitted rerouted endpoints offer194 minutes, at most145.5 kWh, against130.9889 kWh required, leaving14.5111 kWh margin at both tariffs. Thus more total energy can accompany a viable change in charging access. Passing these cuts does not prove a charging schedule; the earlier independent replay provides the separate positive witness. Under the stated ideal assumptions, the negative reference margins are an obstruction to that topology, not merely rejection of one old timed charging schedule.
These classical inequalities are not a new theorem, a tolerance-qualified code certificate or proof about every possible route collection. Passing ignores earlier SOC prefixes, headroom and allocation conflicts. The other full-graph INF_OR_UNBD cases remain unresolved, and the earlier cost experiment still has only2 of8 interactions defined with a null complete-cohort mean. No feasibility penalty, survivor mean, new learning gate or original status was substituted after the result.
Next is a separately admitted all-declared-mode energy/capacity outer-cut diagnostic at the same fixed fleet count, including known feasible controls. It asks whether the two unresolved cases face an ideal resource barrier regardless of route choice, before more routing or training. That direction requires its own exact owned-case field/source/command freeze; no such case access or calculation is launched by this closeout. There is no cap scan, retry, refit or population/publication claim. The diagnostic used0.04 displayed CPU seconds and0.07 wall seconds; charges and historical unknowns remain explicit. Both learned families' failed practical margin remains unchanged.
